description: This file defines the ConfigurationDomainService interface, outlining various configuration-related methods within the Fineract project, including features toggles, entity retrievals, and cache management.

classes.name: ConfigurationDomainService
classes.description: Interface that declares methods for accessing and manipulating configuration settings within the system.

methods.name: isMakerCheckerEnabledForTask
methods.description: Checks if the maker-checker process is enabled for a specific task identified by permission code.

methods.name: getAllowedLoanStatusesForExternalAssetTransfer
methods.description: Returns a list of loan statuses permitted for external asset transfer.

methods.name: getAllowedLoanStatusesOfDelayedSettlementForExternalAssetTransfer
methods.description: Returns a list of loan statuses allowed for delayed settlement in external asset transfer.

methods.name: isSameMakerCheckerEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the maker-checker process is universally enabled.

methods.name: isAmazonS3Enabled
methods.description: Checks if Amazon S3 integration is enabled.

methods.name: isRescheduleFutureRepaymentsEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if rescheduling of future repayments is enabled.

methods.name: isRescheduleRepaymentsOnHolidaysEnabled
methods.description: Checks if rescheduling repayments on holidays is permitted.

methods.name: allowTransactionsOnHolidayEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if transactions are allowed on holidays.

methods.name: allowTransactionsOnNonWorkingDayEnabled
methods.description: Checks if transactions are permissible on non-working days.

methods.name: isConstraintApproachEnabledForDatatables
methods.description: Determines if the constraint approach is enabled for data tables.

methods.name: isEhcacheEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether Ehcache caching is enabled.

methods.name: updateCache
methods.description: Refreshes or invalidates cache for a given cache type.

methods.name: retrievePenaltyWaitPeriod
methods.description: Returns the duration to wait before penalties are applied.

methods.name: isPasswordForcedResetEnable
methods.description: Checks if forced password reset policy is enabled.

methods.name: retrievePasswordLiveTime
methods.description: Gets the lifespan of a password before it expires.

methods.name: retrieveGraceOnPenaltyPostingPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves period grace allowed for penalty posting.

methods.name: retrieveOpeningBalancesContraAccount
methods.description: Returns the account ID used as contra for opening balances.

methods.name: isSavingsInterestPostingAtCurrentPeriodEnd
methods.description: Points whether savings interest is posted at the end of current period.

methods.name: retrieveFinancialYearBeginningMonth
methods.description: Gets the month in which the financial year begins.

methods.name: retrieveMinAllowedClientsInGroup
methods.description: Returns the minimum allowed clients in a group.

methods.name: retrieveMaxAllowedClientsInGroup
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of clients allowed in a group.

methods.name: isMeetingMandatoryForJLGLoans
methods.description: Indicates if meetings are mandatory for JLG loans.

methods.name: getRoundingMode
methods.description: Provides the mode used for rounding financial figures.

methods.name: isBackdatePenaltiesEnabled
methods.description: Checks if backdating penalties is allowed.

methods.name: isOrganisationstartDateEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if the start date of the organization is enabled.

methods.name: retrieveOrganisationStartDate
methods.description: Returns the organization's start date.

methods.name: isPaymentTypeApplicableForDisbursementCharge
methods.description: Determines if a particular payment type applies to disbursement charges.

methods.name: isInterestChargedFromDateSameAsDisbursementDate
methods.description: Checks if interest start date is same as disbursement date.

methods.name: isSkippingMeetingOnFirstDayOfMonthEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if skipping meetings on the first day of the month is permitted.

methods.name: isInterestToBeRecoveredFirstWhenGreaterThanEMI
methods.description: Determines if interest is recovered before EMI when greater than EMI amount.

methods.name: isPrincipalCompoundingDisabledForOverdueLoans
methods.description: Indicates if principal compounding is disabled for overdue loans.

methods.name: retreivePeriodInNumberOfDaysForSkipMeetingDate
methods.description: Retrieves the number of days to skip for meetings.

methods.name: isChangeEmiIfRepaymentDateSameAsDisbursementDateEnabled
methods.description: Checks if changing EMI when repayment date coincides with disbursement date is enabled.

methods.name: isDailyTPTLimitEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if daily TPT limit enforcement is enabled.

methods.name: getDailyTPTLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit value for daily TPT.

methods.name: removeGlobalConfigurationPropertyDataFromCache
methods.description: Removes a specified configuration property from cache.

methods.name: isSMSOTPDeliveryEnabled
methods.description: Checks if SMS OTP delivery is enabled.

methods.name: isEmailOTPDeliveryEnabled
methods.description: Checks if Email OTP delivery is enabled.

methods.name: retrieveOTPCharacterLength
methods.description: Retrieves the length of OTP characters.

methods.name: retrieveOTPLiveTime
methods.description: Provides the validity period of OTP.

methods.name: isSubRatesEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if sub-rates are enabled.

methods.name: isFirstRepaymentDateAfterRescheduleAllowedOnHoliday
methods.description: Checks if first repayment date after reschedule is allowed on holidays.

methods.name: getAccountMappingForPaymentType
methods.description: Gets account mapping configuration for payment types.

methods.name: getAccountMappingForCharge
methods.description: Provides account mapping for charges.

methods.name: isNextDayFixedDepositInterestTransferEnabledForPeriodEnd
methods.description: Checks if next-day interest transfer for fixed deposits at period end is enabled.

methods.name: retrievePivotDateConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for pivot date.

methods.name: isRelaxingDaysConfigForPivotDateEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if relaxing days configuration for pivot date is enabled.

methods.name: retrieveRelaxingDaysConfigForPivotDate
methods.description: Gets the number of relaxing days configured for pivot date.

methods.name: isBusinessDateEnabled
methods.description: Checks if business date features are enabled.

methods.name: isCOBDateAdjustmentEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if date adjustment for close of business date is enabled.

methods.name: isReversalTransactionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if reversal transactions are permitted.

methods.name: retrieveExternalEventsPurgeDaysCriteria
methods.description: Retrieves the purge days criteria for external events.

methods.name: retrieveProcessedCommandsPurgeDaysCriteria
methods.description: Retrieves the purge days criteria for processed commands.

methods.name: retrieveRepaymentDueDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days for repayment due.

methods.name: retrieveRepaymentOverdueDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days considered overdue for repayments.

methods.name: isExternalIdAutoGenerationEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if external ID auto-generation is enabled.

methods.name: isAddressEnabled
methods.description: Checks if address features are enabled.

methods.name: isCOBBulkEventEnabled
methods.description: Checks if bulk COB events are enabled.

methods.name: retrieveExternalEventBatchSize
methods.description: Returns the batch size for external events processing.

methods.name: retrieveReportExportS3FolderName
methods.description: Retrieves the S3 folder name for report exports.

methods.name: getAccrualDateConfigForCharge
methods.description: Provides configuration for accrual dates related to charges.

methods.name: getNextPaymentDateConfigForLoan
methods.description: Returns configuration for the next payment date for loans.

methods.name: isImmediateChargeAccrualPostMaturityEnabled
methods.description: Checks if immediate charge accrual post maturity is enabled.

methods.name: getAssetOwnerTransferOustandingInterestStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the strategy for handling outstanding interest during asset transfer.
